verdict.rationale: Superset provides building blocks: its CLI can be driven from CI, and its SDK and MCP server can launch an agent with a prompt in a fresh worktree. Results land in a reviewable workspace where a PR can be created from the diff viewer. However, nothing in the evidence shows a CI-failure trigger, automatic diagnosis of failed workflows, or automatic PR proposal, so a team would have to script the whole pipeline themselves. Missing for 10: a native CI-failure trigger or integration, automated failure diagnosis, automatic PR creation without manual steps, and any hands-on corroboration of a CI-fix workflow.
